user_notice: another agent is doing project work including small changes to canonical Plans documents

notice_observation.interpretation: the external changes had not appeared in this checkout at the notice observation; they may arrive later

current_audit_boundary.input_authority: the already-frozen Audit005 source snapshots, excerpts, catalogs, owner-merge artifacts and hash-pinned evidence

drift_handling.monitor_mode: path and hash inventory only; never consume moving live prose in active frozen transactions
drift_handling.capture_when: after the external writer is terminal or before Audit005 final certification, whichever comes first
drift_handling.settled_delta: compute canonical Plans path and semantic-window differences from the Audit005 frozen input snapshot to the settled live tree
drift_handling.delta_audit: run blind coverage, feature catalog, owner reconciliation, external research, scenario/adversarial review and certification only for new or changed semantic windows plus directly affected joins
drift_handling.unchanged_work_reuse: retain existing validated Audit005 lineage for unchanged source hashes
drift_handling.final_completion_gate: Audit005 cannot claim current-live-HEAD completeness until the settled delta audit is independently checkpointed and merged
